main_text.head: DECRETI SYNODI NATIONALIS CARENTONII AD MATRONAM sub finem Anni 1644. & initium An. 1645. congregatæ.
SENTENTIÆ IOSVÆ PLACÆI, illi Decreto consentaneæ, DE IMPVTATIONE PRIMI ADÆ PECCATI, EXPLICATIO ET DEFENSIO.
CAPVT PRIMVM.
main_text.p: DEcretum Synodi sic se habet, vertente è Gallico in Latinum Sermonem D. Garissolio, in Ecclesia & Academia Montalbanensi Verbi Dei Ministro & SS. Theologiæ Professore.

p.i: CVM relatum fuisset ad Synodum, scripta quædam, alia typis evulgata, alia manu exarata prodijsse, quæ totam rationem peccati originalis sola corruptione hæreditaria in omnibus hominibus inhærente definiunt, & primi peccati Adæ imputationem negant: Damnauit Synodus doctrinam ejusmodi, quatenus peccati Originalis naturam ad corruptionem hæreditaria

page.notes: Woodcut ornament band at the top of the page; not transcribed. The last line of the paragraph is cut short by the page end and carries the word "hæredi-" with a printed hyphen. The line "CVM relatum..." has its large initial C joined to the word. Several faint show-through marks are present and were not transcribed. The text of the final paragraph is partly illegible at the right edge, and the rendering above follows the visible letters.
